footnote_text: Represents additional shares of phantom stock/RSUs credited to the reporting person's account under the Amended and Restated GATX Directors' Phantom Stock Plan ("Phantom Stock Plan") and the Amended and Restated GATX Corporation Directors' Voluntary Deferred Fee Plan ("Deferred Fee Plan") on the transaction date. Each share of phantom stock/RSU represents the right to receive one share of Issuer's common stock upon settlement. The shares of phantom stock/RSUs are generally payable on a deferred basis in common stock at the election of the reporting person upon the reporting person's termination of service on the Issuer's board of directors. || Represents 72 shares of phantom stock/RSUs acquired pursuant to the dividend reinvestment feature of the Phantom Stock Plan and the Deferred Fee Plan.
